chef: Your number arrives on night 1, before anyone has claimed. A 0 means evil players are spread out; a 1 or more means look for evil players sitting together.
investigator: One of your two players is the Minion you were shown. Share it early so town can test both; a Recluse might be one of them.
washerwoman: You know one of two players is a certain Townsfolk. Ask who claims it: if one does, you have confirmed a good player.
librarian: Your pair holds an Outsider, or none are in play. A Drunk in your pair explains a lot of odd information.
empath: Each night you count evil among your living neighbours. When a neighbour dies your neighbours change, so keep a record night by night in your notebook (B).
fortuneteller: Pick two players each night and note the answers. One good player is your red herring, so a single yes is not proof.
undertaker: You learn what the executed player really was. This is the best check on whether town executed well; share it.
monk: Protect someone the Demon may want dead, such as a strong information role. Use /protect <seat> when the Storyteller wakes you.
slayer: One shot. Use /slay <seat> in the day once town has narrowed things down; a miss still clears that player of being the Demon.
soldier: The Demon can't kill you, so claiming it can waste their night. Evil may say you are a lying Minion, so prove it by surviving.
ravenkeeper: If you die at night you pick a player and learn their character (/raven <seat>). Pick someone who is unclear.
virgin: If a Townsfolk nominates you first, they are executed at once, which proves them. Invite a trusted player to nominate you.
mayor: Near the end, with three alive, town can choose not to execute and win. The Demon's kill may bounce away from you at night.
grandmother: You know one good player and their character. Keep them safe: if the Demon kills them, you die too.
sailor: You can't die. Each night you drink with a player and one of you is drunk until dusk, so doubt anything you learn.
chambermaid: You learn how many of two players woke for their ability. It is good for catching evil players who claim a role that never wakes.
innkeeper: Two players are safe tonight, but one is drunk. Protect people the Demon wants dead and expect some bad information.
gambler: Guess a player's character correctly and you live. Guess players you are fairly sure of, or it costs you your life.
exorcist: If you pick the Demon, they learn who you are and don't wake. A night with no deaths can show you found them.
gossip: Say something in the day; if it is true, someone dies that night. Make claims you can test, like a player being the Poisoner.
courtier: Once per game, make a character drunk for three days and nights. Pick a dangerous evil role such as the Poisoner or a Demon.
professor: Once per game, bring back a dead Townsfolk. Pick a strong information role that died early.
minstrel: If a Minion is executed, everyone else is drunk the next day. That day's information is not to be trusted.
tealady: If both living neighbours are good, they can't die. It helps confirm your neighbours, so tell town where you sit.
fool: You survive your first death. Claim after, so town knows you are confirmed good.
pacifist: Good players might survive execution. If an executed player lives, they are probably good.
clockmaker: You learn how many seats the Demon sits from its nearest Minion. A 1 means a Minion sits right next to the Demon.
dreamer: Each night you see two characters for a player, one true. Over several nights you can narrow down most players.
snakecharmer: Pick the Demon and you swap: you become an evil, poisoned Demon. Go after players you think are lying.
mathematician: You learn how many abilities misfired today. A high number means a Drunk or Poisoner is active.
flowergirl: You learn if the Demon voted today. Watch who votes on each nomination and compare.
towncrier: You learn if a Minion nominated today. Note every nominator.
oracle: You count evil among the dead. If it goes up after an execution, town killed an evil player.
savant: Each day, visit the Storyteller for one true and one false fact. Look for facts that agree with other players' claims.
seamstress: Once per game, learn if two players are on the same team. Use it on two players who accuse each other.
philosopher: Once per game, take a good character's ability. If that character is in play, they become drunk.
artist: Once per game, ask any yes or no question. Ask something that clears or catches several players at once.
juggler: On day 1, guess up to five players' characters out loud. That night you learn how many you got right.
sage: If the Demon kills you, you learn it is one of two players. Tell town straight away.
noble: Exactly one of your three players is evil. Work with other information to find which.
pixie: You learn an in-play Townsfolk. Claim to be it (be mad about it) and you may gain its ability.
general: Each night, you learn which team the Storyteller thinks is winning. Use it to judge how urgent things are.
king: The Demon knows you are the King. Once the dead outnumber the living, you learn a living character each night.
lycanthrope: Pick a player each night: a good one dies and the Demon doesn't kill. One good player looks evil to you.
engineer: Once per game, change which Minions or Demon are in play. It is strong late in the game.
huntsman: Find the Damsel and turn them into a Townsfolk before a Minion guesses them.
alchemist: You have a Minion's ability on good's side. Ask the Storyteller how it works for you.
cannibal: You gain the ability of the last executed player. If they were evil you get false information, so check after each execution.
amnesiac: You don't know your ability. Guess it each day with the Storyteller and you learn how close you are.
farmer: If you die at night, another good player becomes the Farmer. Your death keeps the role going.
choirboy: If the Demon kills the King, you learn who the Demon is. Keep the King safe and in play.
magician: The Demon thinks you are a Minion and the Minions think you are the Demon. You confuse evil's team.
poppygrower: Evil players don't know each other while you live. Hide your role, because evil wants you dead.
atheist: There may be no evil at all. If you are executed and there is no Demon, good wins.
steward: You know one good player from the start. Use them as a trusted partner.
knight: You know two players who are not the Demon. That clears them of the worst suspicion.
shugenja: You learn whether the nearest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. Look along that side of the circle.
bountyhunter: You know an evil player. If they die, you learn another. One Townsfolk is secretly evil.
highpriestess: Each night, you learn who the Storyteller thinks you should talk to. Go and talk to them.
balloonist: Each night you see a player of a different character type from last night. It slowly maps the town.
preacher: Pick a player each night; a chosen Minion loses their ability. It quietly disables evil.
villageidiot: Learn a player's alignment each night, but one Village Idiot is drunk. Compare notes with the others.
cultleader: You take the alignment of a neighbour. If every good player joins your cult, your team wins.
acrobat: Pick a player each night; if they are drunk or poisoned, you die. Your death points at a Poisoner or Drunk.
alsaahir: Each day, publicly guess the Minions and Demon. Get them all right and good wins.
nightwatchman: Once per game, a player learns you are the Nightwatchman. Use it to prove yourself to someone you trust.
fisherman: Once per game, ask the Storyteller for advice. Save it for when town is stuck.
princess: On day 1, if you nominate and execute a player, the Demon doesn't kill that night.
banshee: If the Demon kills you, everyone learns it and you get double nominations and votes. Use them.
butler: You can only vote if your master votes. Pick a master each night and follow their vote.
saint: If you are executed, your team loses. Claim early so town doesn't execute you.
recluse: You might look evil to information roles. Expect to be suspected and explain why.
drunk: You think you are a Townsfolk, but your ability doesn't work. You don't know it, so play your role in good faith.
goon: The first player to choose you each night is drunk, and you join their team. Your alignment may change.
lunatic: You think you are the Demon, but you are not. Play it out; the real Demon knows who you are.
tinker: You might die at any time. If you die oddly in the day, say you are the Tinker.
moonchild: When you die, publicly choose a player; if they are good, they die. Choose someone you think is evil.
mutant: Don't claim to be an Outsider, or you might be executed. Bluff as a Townsfolk.
barber: If you die, the Demon may swap two players' characters. Expect confusion after your death.
sweetheart: When you die, one player is drunk from then on. Claim it so town can account for bad information.
klutz: When you die, publicly choose a player: if they are evil, your team loses. Pick someone you trust.
golem: You may nominate once per game; if the nominee is not the Demon, they die. Make that nomination count.
damsel: The Minions know you are in play. If one guesses you, good loses, so don't make it obvious.
snitch: Each Minion gets three bluffs. Tell town so they treat Minion claims with care.
heretic: Whoever wins loses, and whoever loses wins. Keep it quiet until it matters.
puzzlemaster: One player is drunk. Guess who once: right and you learn the Demon, wrong and you get false information.
hermit: You have every Outsider ability. Ask the Storyteller what that means here.
ogre: On night 1, pick a player; you join their team without knowing which.
plaguedoctor: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability. Expect something strange after.
hatter: If you die, evil players may change characters. Watch for new behaviour after.
politician: If you are most responsible for your team losing, you switch sides and win.
zealot: With five or more alive you must vote on every nomination. Raise your hand (U) when the clock reaches you.
poisoner: Each night poison a player (/poison <seat> when the Storyteller wakes you). Poison the strongest information role, then help town doubt them.
spy: You see the Grimoire, so you know every character. Bluff a role you know is not in play, and you may look good to information.
baron: There are two extra Outsiders. Help hide them, or claim to be one yourself.
scarletwoman: If the Demon dies with five or more alive, you become the Demon. Keep a low profile so you survive.
godfather: You know which Outsiders are in play. If one died today, you kill tonight.
devilsadvocate: Protect a player from dying by execution. Save the Demon if they are on the block.
assassin: Once per game, kill anyone, even someone protected. Use it on a key information role.
mastermind: If the Demon is executed, play one more day; execute a good player then and evil wins.
witch: Curse a player each night; if they nominate tomorrow, they die. It discourages strong players from nominating.
cerenovus: Make a player claim a character tomorrow, or they may be executed. It creates confusion.
pithag: Change a player's character each night. Making a new Demon can cause random deaths.
eviltwin: You and a good twin know each other. Good can't win while you both live, and evil wins if the good twin is executed.
mezepheles: You have a secret word. The first good player to say it turns evil that night. Steer talk towards it.
fearmonger: Choose a player each night; if you nominate and execute them, their team loses. Everyone knows when you change target.
psychopath: Each day before nominations you may kill a player publicly with your axe. If executed, you play rock-paper-scissors (/roshambo rock, paper or scissors) to survive.
marionette: You think you are good, but you are evil and sit next to the Demon. You don't know it.
boomdandy: If you are executed, all but three players die, then the town points at someone. It is a gamble for everyone.
harpy: Pick two players each night: the first must say the second is evil tomorrow, or one of them might die.
wizard: Once per game, make a wish. The Storyteller may grant it at a price.
widow: On night 1 you see the Grimoire and poison a player. One good player knows a Widow is in play.
xaan: On night X, all Townsfolk are poisoned. X is the number of Outsiders.
wraith: At night you roam in Spectator. Come into a house through its door to hear it; through a wall you can only watch. You are brought to evil players when they wake. Players with a lit Spirit Lantern can catch you.
summoner: You get three bluffs. On night 3, turn a player into the Demon.
goblin: If you claim to be the Goblin when nominated and are executed, evil wins. Time it well.
vizier: Everyone knows you are the Vizier and you can't die in the day. You can force executions.
organgrinder: Votes are secret while you live. Choose each night if you are drunk.
boffin: The Demon has a good character's ability. Help them use it.
imp: Kill each night with /attack <seat> when the Storyteller wakes you. If you're in danger, you can kill yourself to pass the Imp to a Minion.
pukka: Each night poison a player; the previously poisoned player dies. Deaths come a night late.
shabaloth: Kill two players each night. One you killed may come back.
po: Skip a kill, then kill three the next night. Use it to confuse town.
zombuul: You only kill if no one died in the day. Your first death doesn't count, but you look dead.
fanggu: If you attack an Outsider, they become the Fang Gu and you die. Avoid it, or use it to escape.
vigormortis: Minions you kill keep their ability. Killing a Minion can help evil.
nodashii: Your two Townsfolk neighbours are poisoned. Expect bad information near you.
vortox: All Townsfolk information is false. If no one is executed in a day, evil wins.
legion: Most players are Legion. Executions fail if only evil votes.
lleech: You choose a host on night 1; you die only if they die. Protect your host.
alhadikhia: Choose three players each night; each chooses to live or die. If all three choose to live, all three die.
riot: From day 3, nominees die and must nominate someone else at once.
leviathan: Everyone knows you're in play. Evil wins after day 5 or if more than one good player is executed.
yaggababble: You have a secret phrase. Each time it is said in public, a player might die.
lilmonsta: Minions pass the Demon between them. Hide who has it.
kazali: You choose who the Minions are. Then you kill each night.
ojo: Name a character to kill. If it isn't in play, the Storyteller picks who dies.
lordoftyphon: The evil players sit in a line with you in the middle. Their seats give you away.
thief: Each night pick a player; their vote counts negative tomorrow.
bureaucrat: Each night pick a player; their vote counts three times tomorrow.
gunslinger: After the first vote is counted each day, you may shoot a player who voted. Use the gun the Storyteller gives you.
scapegoat: If a player of your team is executed, you may be executed instead.
beggar: You need a dead player's vote token to vote. You learn the giver's alignment.
apprentice: On night 1 you gain a Townsfolk ability if good, or a Minion ability if evil.
matron: Each day you can swap seats around. Players can't leave their seats to talk in private.
judge: Once per game, force an execution to pass or fail.
voudon: Only you and the dead can vote, and no majority is needed.
bishop: Only the Storyteller nominates, and they must nominate an opposing player each day.
barista: Each night a player gets sober, healthy and true information, or their ability works twice.
harlot: Visit a player each night; if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.
butcher: After the first execution each day you may nominate again.
deviant: If you are funny today, you can't be exiled.
bonecollector: Once per game, regain a dead player's ability until dusk.
cacklejack: Each day pick a player; a different player changes character tonight.
gangster: Once per day, kill a living neighbour if your other neighbour agrees.
gnome: Everyone knows your buddy's alignment. You may kill anyone who nominates them.
